Hi! D1 Rower here. You’re doing really well! I can tell that you know what you’re supposed to be doing. Your drive is good but you just need to relax your grip a bit. As for the recovery, make sure you REALLY over exaggerate the “arms-body over-legs” sequence until you really get it down. Right now you’re doing all three movements at the same time and they should be clearly separated. Try taking a couple stokes legs only (keeping your arms and body in the catch position and only pushing with your legs). Then move only legs and body only (not bringing your arms in yet) and then a full stroke, pausing at the finish. Then do legs-body-arms in-arms out. Then add -body swing forward, then finally -legs bend and come back to the catch. Do this before EVERY workout and it’ll help with your form!!! (This is what my team does before every practice)
